name: Dimitrov square-free: lower branch theta*(c) = (c+3)/5 on (1, 16/13]
comment: Companion to dimitrov_squarefree.json, identical region, slices on the lower branch of the piecewise-linear profile. Binding set {tail_S2, h_average, vdC_q0_via_S9}, attained at zeta = eta = (4c-3)/5. See the main file for the full transcription notes.

provenance.tail_S2: Section 6, display (50): S^(2)_c(x) << x^c z^{-1} = x^{c-zeta}. The divisors beyond z are handled trivially.
provenance.h_average: Display (37), first term x^c H^{-1} d^{-2} with H = x^eta/d, giving x^{c-eta} d^{-1}; sum over d <= z contributes log z only.
provenance.vdC_q1: Display (37), second term x^{(3c+1)/6} H^{1/6} d^{-1}: Lemma 2 (Graham-Kolesnik Thm 2.9) at q = 1, Q = 2. With H = x^eta/d this is x^{(1+eta+3c)/6} d^{-7/6} and the d-sum converges. Note F ~ h x exactly, since K^gamma d^{2 gamma} ~ x by (27) and (34).
provenance.vdC_q0_via_S9: Displays (43)-(46): S^(6) << x^{1-c} S^(9) with Lemma 2 at q = 0, giving x^{(3-2c)/2} H^{3/2} d^{-3/2}; the d-sum converges.
